name: University Grants Commission (UGC)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Statutory body created by the UGC Act 1956 to coordinate, determine and maintain standards of university/higher education, disburse grants, and recognize universities in India.
notes: Website content could not be directly re-fetched due to proxy access restriction on gov.in domains in this session; established year corroborated by WebSearch snippets from ugc.gov.in and education.gov.in.

name: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Statutory national-level apex advisory body (statutory since AICTE Act 1987) for planning, promotion, and coordinated development of technical and management education in India.
notes: Set up Nov 1945 as an advisory body; granted statutory status by Act of Parliament in 1987. Two established_year candidates exist (1945 origin vs 1987 statutory status) - 1945 recorded as founding year, statutory conversion noted here.

name: National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Statutory body regulating and maintaining norms/standards for teacher education programmes and institutions across India, under the NCTE Act 1993 (enforced 1 July 1995).
notes: Existed as a non-statutory advisory body from 1973; became statutory 1 July 1995 under NCTE Act 1993. 1995 recorded as the statutory establishment year.

name: National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET)
parent_ministry_or_department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, Government of India
mandate_summary: Overarching national regulator for the technical/vocational education and training (TVET) ecosystem; sets standards, accredits awarding bodies, assessment agencies and skill councils, subsuming NSDA and erstwhile NCVT.
notes: Notified 5 December 2018; became fully operational 1 August 2020.

name: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Autonomous organisation that assists and advises the Central and State Governments on academic matters related to school education, and develops the National Curriculum Framework and NCERT textbooks.
notes: Established 27 July 1961; began formal operation 1 September 1961; formed by merger of seven earlier government organisations.

name: National Institute of Open Schooling (NIOS)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: National board providing school and vocational education through open and distance learning at secondary and senior secondary level, chiefly for out-of-school youth and adults.
data_source: NIOS Official Website (cross-checked with WebSearch summary)
notes: Established 12 November 1989. Headquarters address (A-24/25, Institutional Area, Sector-62, Noida) taken from search snippet, not independently re-fetched.

name: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of School Education and Literacy, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: National-level board that conducts Class X and XII board examinations and affiliates schools across India and abroad following a common curriculum.
notes: Originated 1929 as Board of High School and Intermediate Education for Rajputana, Central India, Gwalior and Ajmer-Merwara; renamed Central Board of Secondary Education in 1952; HQ shifted to New Delhi in 1962.

name: Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations (CISCE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Not a government body - private educational board registered under the Societies Registration Act; examinations recognized by Ministry of Education / state governments
mandate_summary: Private, non-governmental national-level board conducting the ICSE (Class X) and ISC (Class XII) examinations; recognized by central and state governments.
notes: Established 3 November 1958. Multiple similar-looking domains found in search (cisce.org, cisceboard.org, cisce.net, csisce.org.in) - cisce.org selected as most consistent with the registered-office contact details found (council@cisce.org). Direct fetch to confirm was blocked by session proxy policy; confidence lowered accordingly.

name: National Testing Agency (NTA)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Autonomous, self-sustained premier testing organisation that conducts entrance examinations for admission/fellowship in higher educational institutions, including JEE Main, NEET-UG, UGC-NET and CUET.
notes: Established November 2017. Headquarters at NSIC-MDBP Building, Okhla Industrial Estate, New Delhi (per search snippet).

name: National Assessment and Accreditation Council (NAAC)
parent_ministry_or_department: Autonomous body funded by UGC, Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Assesses and accredits higher education institutions (universities and colleges) in India based on quality parameters, in response to the National Policy on Education 1986 recommendations.
data_source: UGC Official Website (NAAC page) / WebSearch cross-check
notes: Established 1994; headquartered in Bengaluru. Direct fetch of naac.gov.in was blocked by session proxy policy, so confirmation relies on UGC page summary and secondary sources.

name: National Board of Accreditation (NBA)
parent_ministry_or_department: Autonomous body under Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India (originally established by AICTE)
mandate_summary: Accredits technical education programmes (engineering, management, pharmacy, architecture, hospitality etc.) at the programme level rather than institution level.
data_source: WebSearch cross-check (NBA official site + Ministry of Education page)
notes: Established by AICTE in 1994; became an autonomous body in 2010. Headquarters: NBCC Place, Bhisham Pitamah Marg, Pragati Vihar, New Delhi (per search snippet).

name: National Institutional Ranking Framework (NIRF)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Methodology adopted by the Ministry of Education to rank higher education institutions across India annually (India Rankings) using parameters such as teaching/learning, research, graduation outcomes, outreach and perception.
notes: Approved and launched 29 September 2015; first India Rankings released in 2016.

name: All India Survey on Higher Education (AISHE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
mandate_summary: Annual web-based survey of all higher education institutions in India, collecting data on enrolment, teachers, infrastructure and outcomes used for education planning and policy formulation.
notes: First survey cycle conducted for 2010-11; some secondary sources cite 2011 as launch year. Ministry of Education (formerly MHRD) is the parent department.

name: State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT) Telangana
parent_ministry_or_department: School Education Department, Government of Telangana
mandate_summary: State-level academic authority responsible for curriculum framework, textbook development, teacher training and educational research for school education in Telangana.
notes: Originally established 27 July 1967 as the unified (undivided) Andhra Pradesh SCERT; became a separate Telangana entity in June 2014 following state bifurcation. established_year field reflects the Telangana-specific entity's formation, not the 1967 origin.

name: Board of Secondary Education Telangana (BSE Telangana / SSC Board)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of School Education, Government of Telangana
mandate_summary: Regulates and conducts the SSC (Class X) and Open SSC examinations and affiliates schools across Telangana; functions as an independent department under the state government (also referred to as the Directorate of Government Examinations, Telangana).
notes: Established 10 May 2016 following post-bifurcation reorganisation. Several near-identical domains appear in search results (bse.telangana.gov.in, bsetelanganagov.in, bset.ac) - bse.telangana.gov.in selected as the canonical .gov.in domain, but direct fetch to confirm was blocked (403) by session proxy policy.

name: Telangana State Board of Intermediate Education (TSBIE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Intermediate Education, Government of Telangana
mandate_summary: Autonomous statutory body regulating and supervising intermediate (Class XI-XII) education in Telangana, including affiliation of junior colleges and conduct of examinations.
notes: Formally constituted 21 October 2014 with retrospective effect from Telangana's formation on 2 June 2014. Headquartered at Nampally, Hyderabad.

name: Telangana State Council of Higher Education (TSCHE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Higher Education Department, Government of Telangana
mandate_summary: Advises the Telangana state government on higher education matters, coordinates state-level common entrance tests (e.g. TS EAMCET), and undertakes planning/perspective development of higher education in the state.
notes: Came into existence by Order of the Government of Telangana adopting the APSCHE Act 16 of 1988, pursuant to the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act 2014. Direct fetch of tgche.ac.in was blocked (403) by session proxy policy; relied on WebSearch summary.

name: State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT) Andhra Pradesh
parent_ministry_or_department: School Education Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
mandate_summary: State-level academic authority for curriculum development, textbooks, teacher training and educational research for school education in Andhra Pradesh; the first SCERT established in India.
data_source: SCERT AP Portal / secondary news source on 2025 office relocation
notes: Established 27 July 1967 by amalgamating the State Institute of Education, State Bureau of Educational and Vocational Guidance, and State Science Education Unit; was the first SCERT in India. Office relocated from Vijayawada to Atmakuru, Mangalagiri, Guntur District around March 2025 per a Deccan Chronicle report - treated as a secondary source, not government-confirmed.

name: Board of Secondary Education Andhra Pradesh (BSEAP)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of School Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh
mandate_summary: Regulates and conducts the SSC (Class X) examinations and affiliates schools across Andhra Pradesh; also functions as the Directorate of Government Examinations, Andhra Pradesh.
data_source: WebSearch cross-check (Wikipedia and secondary education portals - conflicting dates found)
notes: Conflicting establishment dates found: some sources cite 1953 (informal genesis after AP's formation as a linguistic state), others cite formal establishment via G.O.Ms.No.63, Education (W-2) Department dated 16-01-1969. 1969 (the GO-documented date) recorded here as the more specific, citable date; 1953 noted as an alternate/informal claim. Not independently verified against a primary GO document, hence lower confidence.

name: Board of Intermediate Education Andhra Pradesh (BIEAP)
parent_ministry_or_department: Department of Intermediate Education, Government of Andhra Pradesh
mandate_summary: Regulates and conducts intermediate (Class XI-XII) examinations and affiliates junior colleges across Andhra Pradesh.
notes: Established 1971, originally headquartered in Hyderabad; relocated to Vijayawada after 2014 state reorganisation and subsequently to Tadepalli, Guntur District. Multiple near-identical domains found (bie.ap.gov.in, bieap.gov.in, bieap-gov.org, bieap.apcfss.in) - bieap.gov.in selected based on the office-relocation source; not independently re-fetched.

name: Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)
parent_ministry_or_department: Higher Education Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
mandate_summary: Statutory body advising the Andhra Pradesh state government on higher education matters, overseeing planning and development of higher education, and coordinating state-level common entrance tests.
notes: Came into existence 20 May 1988 under Act 16 of 1988. Exact current headquarters city/address (post-2014 reorganisation, likely Guntur District/Vijayawada area) could not be confirmed via available search results or direct fetch (blocked by session proxy policy); headquarters_city marked PENDING_VERIFICATION.
